name: Nerbgen

attributes.attribute: Irish heroine whose name means the vehement
one of the five wives of Partholon
hero of the Book of Invasions

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nerbgen is an Irish heroine. Her name means the vehement. The Book of Invasions lists her with the four other women married to the hero Partholon. The others are Aife, Elgnad, also called Dealgnaid, Cichban, and Cerbnat. Nothing else is known about her.

okr.objective: Nerbgen is one of the five wives of the hero Partholon.
key_results: The Book of Invasions lists her among Partholon's five wives.
The other wives are Aife, Elgnad, Cichban, and Cerbnat.
